chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ismail ibn Mihran, from Mukhlad Abu al-Shukr, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The time during which the imprecation (Mubahila) is performed is what is between the emergence of the dawn and the emergence of the sun.
A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Makhlad Abu al-Shukr, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) — similar to it.

key_terms.تُبَاهِلُ: Imprecation (Mubahila), a ritual of invoking divine curse upon the lying party

ai.seo_question: What is the specific time range for performing Mubahila according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the specific temporal window for Mubahila between dawn and sunrise, reflecting the juristic precision of the Imams regarding ritual timing. It contextualizes the event narrated in Surah Al Imran, linking the legal ruling to the historical incident of the Prophet Muhammad's encounter with the Christians of Najran. The specification underscores the importance of synchronizing ritual acts with natural signs, a key theme in Shia fiqh.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Mukhlad Abu Al Shakr, from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
The timing during which the imprecation is to be performed is what is between the emergence of the dawn up to the emergence of the sun’.

A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Makhlad Abu Al Shakr, from Abu Hamza, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> – similar to it.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Isma’Il ibn Mehran from Mukhallad abu al-Shukr from abu Hamza al-Thumali from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said, ‘
The time for al-Mubahalah is between dawn and sunrise.’”
A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Muhammad ibn Isma’Il from Mukhallad abu al-Shukr from abu Hamza from abu Ja’far (a.s.) a similar Hadith.
